verdict.rationale: Morph documents a public, machine-readable model catalog with per-model list prices, linked from its llms.txt and requiring no sales contact. It also documents token billing and a half-price standby tier. However, the evidence does not show that prices are quoted per token for every hosted model, and no human-readable pricing table is evidenced. missing for 10: explicit per-token price figures, confirmation that every hosted model (including specialized tools like Fast Apply, Compact and Reflexes) has a published price, a human-readable pricing page, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales

citations.quote: For machine-readable models, limits and these list prices, fetch https://www.morphllm.com/api/models/json?prices=list
